name: settings-pane-titles-read-in-light
description: Settings in light appearance: the pane titles and the Import card text contrast with the pane ground. The recorded bug drew them dark on dark.

actions.note: gate: the startup tab committed, so the app is up
Atrium frontmost, so the chord reaches it
no vlog wait, so the capture below starts before the page is ready
gate: the native settings window was created
gate: the appearance reached the app

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="general"]'); if (!b) { return 'no-pane'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

(() => { const rgba = (s) => { const n = (s.match(/[\d.]+/g) || []).map(Number); const c = s.startsWith('color(') ? n.slice(0, 3).map((v) => v * 255) : n.slice(0, 3); return [...c, n.length > 3 ? n[3] : 1]; }; const lum = (c) => 0.2126 * c[0] + 0.7152 * c[1] + 0.0722 * c[2]; const gap = (el) => { const g = rgba(getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.settings-body')).backgroundColor); const f = rgba(getComputedStyle(el).color); return Math.abs(lum(f.map((v, i) => f[3] * v + (1 - f[3]) * g[i])) - lum(g)); }; const el = document.querySelector('.settings-heading'); if (!el) { return 'missing'; } return gap(el) >= 100; })()
actions.note: the pane title contrasts with the ground
